overview.approach: Web-First Development moving to Cross-Platform Mobile Apps
overview.rationale: Building a web application first allows rapid prototyping, easy user acquisition without app store friction, and testing core features and business logic before deploying native mobile apps.

features.feature: PostGIS for high-performance geofencing (500m to 5km radius queries)
Realtime WebSockets for local chat and feeds
Object Storage for user uploads and verification docs
High SEO optimization for local service searches
Direct connection to existing Supabase backend
Single codebase for iOS and Android deployment via Expo EAS

phase.name: Web MVP Launch
phase.step: Build responsive web app using Next.js, fully optimized for mobile viewports.
Set up PostgreSQL database with PostGIS extension for geolocation queries.
Implement core modules: Geo-located feed, local services directory, and post creation.
Launch in a pilot neighborhood to test engagement and gather feedback.

phase.name: PWA & Mobile-First Enhancements
phase.step: Configure PWA manifest allowing users to 'Add to Home Screen'.
Integrate Web Push Notifications and browser Geolocation API.
Optimize merchant dashboards for desktop and web access.

phase.name: Cross-Platform Native Apps
phase.step: Scaffold an Expo React Native mobile project (or monorepo structure).
Hook mobile app directly into the active Supabase backend schema.
Implement native capabilities: APNs/FCM Push Notifications, native camera access, and background location.
Publish iOS to Apple App Store and Android to Google Play via Expo EAS.

feature.name: SEO & Local Discovery
feature.web: High (Indexed local pages, searchable via Google)

feature.name: Merchant Admin Dashboard
feature.web: Optimized desktop layout for running ads & analytics

feature.name: Geofencing & Real-time Alerts
feature.mobile: Native background location & instant OS push alerts
